name: golden-mode-reset

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 vt plan

description: A golden C4 screen case, graded by the U4 libghostty-vt round trip: the sibling .bin is raw output fed to a fresh parser; the dump the worker then produces is fed to a second parser and must show the same screen and modes. **No expected screen is stored** (F14: expected screens are never hand-written, they come from the round trip at a pinned engine); the fixture asserts every carried mode back to its reset state after the second chunk, the full state the dump must emit.
